test_title: PYST 42: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II & III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some doctors are tigers.

All tigers are umbrellas.

Some umbrellas are buses.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some doctors are umbrellas.

II. Some tigers are umbrellas.

III. Some buses are umbrellas.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58da579dd09a905a08a7fa55f08d73622c6e8f290af7281be9aec715f50c412a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some doctors are umbrellas. → **Follows** (As, Some doctors are tigers and All tigers are umbrellas)

II. Some tigers are umbrellas. → Follows (As, All tigers are umbrellas)

III. Some buses are umbrellas. → Follows (As, Some umbrellas are buses)

Hence, '**All conclusions follow**' is the correct answer.
